adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code only normalizes `category_id` when it is blank (`host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`) and otherwise trusts the client-provided `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without checking that the referenced `Category` exists. The finding’s claim that this will "fail with a DB foreign-key-style error" is not verifiable from the diff (no FK constraint is shown), but adding an existence validation/check would be a concrete robustness improvement.
